children: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd (AMSL) has been awarded the Transfer of Technology (ToT) for the Semi Active Laser Homing System (SALHS), the company said in an exchange filing.
The SALHS technology relates to a precision-guidance system designed to provide in-flight guidance to munitions towards a laser-designated target.

The technology transfer will strengthen the company's capabilities in indigenous precision-guided defence technologies and support its long-term strategy of developing and manufacturing advanced, mission-critical defence systems, it said.

"The Company's Board of Directors and Management consider this award a defining milestone in Apollo Micro Systems Limited's growth journey, underscoring the Company's technological capabilities, execution excellence, and expanding strategic role in India's critical Defence technology ecosystem, particularly in Missile Warfare capabilities," the company said.
Shares of the company settled 4.58 percent lower at Rs 368.90 per share on the NSE.
